doc.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12

title: Closing: leaving the record, learning guitar and fingerpicking in the music school
summary: Allen wraps up and leaves the record; Mosley describes learning to read music and guitar in Angola's music school, his picking technique, and waiting for Oster's promised music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Well I'm afraid I'm gonna have to turn it off. We gotta get back to New Orleans. Right there. Alright. So it was nice talking to y'all. Yeah sir. And we'll, I'll leave the record with you though. Alright. So you can hear it all. Excuse me, you said those records will be played where? After? Well right here. But he's got them on sale now. Yeah. But I thought I'd bring that one up to y'all. Yeah. And I'm sure he'll be here in a couple of weeks, you'll see him.
